patterns_en.label: canned openings & filler preambles (In today's fast-paced / I hope this email / It is important)
patterns_en.regex: \b(I hope this (email|message) finds you well|look no further( than)?|without further ado)\b|\b[Ii]n (today'?s?|this|an?)\s+(?:(?:fast-paced|rapidly changing|ever-evolving|constantly shifting|interconnected|dynamic|digital|modern)\s+)+(world|era|landscape|age)\b|[Ii]t('s| is| should be) ((important|worth|crucial|vital|essential) (to note|noting|mentioning|remembering)|(worth noting|worth mentioning))
